await (async(page)=>{
const dict={dad:'papá',mom:'mamá',dog:'perro',cat:'gato',house:'casa',book:'libro',water:'agua',milk:'leche',suitcase:'maleta'};
const events=[];try{
for(let i=0;i<25;i++){
 const containers=page.locator('[data-test^="challenge "]');let challenge=null;
 for(let j=0;j<await containers.count();j++){const x=containers.nth(j);const controls=x.getByRole('radio').or(x.getByRole('button'));for(let k=0;k<await controls.count();k++)if(await controls.nth(k).isVisible()&&await controls.nth(k).isEnabled()){challenge=x;break;}if(challenge)break;}
 const before=await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot();
 if(!challenge){const next=page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true});if(await next.count()&&await next.last().isEnabled()){events.push({checkpoint:before});await next.last().click();await page.waitForTimeout(500);continue;}events.push({stop:'no active challenge',before});break;}
 const old=await challenge.elementHandle();const heading=await challenge.getByRole('heading',{level:1}).innerText();
 if(heading==='Select the matching pairs'){
  const names=await challenge.getByRole('button').allTextContents();const values=names.map(x=>x.replace(/^\d\s*/,'').trim());
  for(const a of values.filter(x=>Object.hasOwn(dict,x))){
   const b=dict[a];if(!values.includes(b))throw Error('Unmapped visible pair: '+a);
   await challenge.getByRole('button',{name:new RegExp('^\d '+a+'$')}).click();
   await challenge.getByRole('button',{name:new RegExp('^\d '+b+'$')}).click();
  }
 }else if(/^Which one of these|^Select the correct meaning/.test(heading)){
  const quote=heading.match(/[“"]([^”"]+)[”"]/);const content=(await challenge.innerText()).split('
').map(x=>x.trim());
  const word=quote?.[1]||Object.keys(dict).find(x=>content.includes(x));const answer=dict[word];if(!answer){events.push({stop:'unmapped prompt',before});break;}
  const options=challenge.getByRole('radio');let found=null;
  for(let j=0;j<await options.count();j++)if((await options.nth(j).innerText()).replace(/\s*\d+$/,'').trim()===answer)found=options.nth(j);
  if(!found){events.push({stop:'unmapped answer',before});break;}
  await found.click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Check',exact:true}).click();
 }else{events.push({stop:'new question type',before});break;}
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).last().waitFor();
 const feedback=await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot();events.push({heading,before,feedback});
 if(/Correct solution:/.test(feedback)){events.push({stop:'unexpected wrong answer'});break;}
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).last().click();
 await old.waitForElementState('hidden',{timeout:15000});
}
return {events,final:await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot()};
}catch(e){return {error:e.message,events,final:await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot()};}})(page);
